column2: [intro]
Obstacles are many, I see them every day
But it's in these challenges that I find my love
I refuse to be trapped, locked in a cage
I fight for hope, to turn the page
Everything is in motion, I am uprooted
Change is my norm, it's my reality
I get lost in time, in eternity
But today is not the day, I will start
The melody plays, sad and torn
Like my wounded soul, which cannot forget
But through the pain, a glimmer of hope
Dancing with my demons, until the last evening
Everything is in motion, I am uprooted
Change is my norm, it's my reality
I get lost in time, in eternity
But today is not the day, I will start
[ solo ]
But despite all that, I struggle to move forward
I need to accept that I can change everything
But sometimes I'm scared, I'm paralyzed
But I will find the strength to reinvent myself
[outro]
